duster.headline: Diesel autos span R195k-R285k; best-matched buy is 2022 TechRoad Auto R249990/47k km (R12.2k under); manual Zen is the bargain wildcard.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, 47051 km, R249900, R12.2k under — matches every criterion.
2022 Zen diesel, 72000 km, R209990, R24.3k under — standout value but manual.
2023 Zen diesel, 44460 km, R244900, R12.8k under; Kia multi-franchise likely takes Duster trade.

alerts: Jetour Hillcrest 2022 Zen sits R24.3k under model — biggest gap in market; worth a manual-tolerance test drive.

caddy.headline: Thin market: single 2020 Crew Bus at R279990/76000 km fits both caps — verify condition and history before committing.

shortlist.note: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus (Kombi-type), 76000 km, R279990 — only option; R20k headroom under cap.

alerts: Crew Bus is a windowed Kombi-type, not a panel van — confirm it suits the need; no price benchmark exists.

jimny.headline: Three 3-door Jimnys under both caps; cheapest 2018 1.3 at R234890/86000 km; 2021 GLX with 25115 km is the low-km value pick.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3, 86000 km, R234890 — older gen, R65k under cap.
2021 1.5 GLX AllGrip, 25115 km, R295995 — lowest km, just under cap.
2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, 78000 km, R289890 — middle option, R10k under cap.

alerts: All three are 3-door; no 5-door Jimnys currently listed.

seltos.headline: Baseline: 22 Seltos captured; cheapest auto is 2021 1.6 EX R210000/100000 km (R37.7k under); expect alerts only on new or changed listings.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, 100000 km, R210000, R37.7k under — cheapest auto; km at limit.
2021 1.6 EX manual, 93800 km, R189900, R44.9k under — biggest gap, but manual.
2022 1.6 EX+ Auto, 97876 km, R234900, R13.7k under; multi-franchise suits Duster trade.

creta.headline: Baseline: 26 Cretas captured; gen2 1.5 autos from R260k; 2024 Premium Auto R279999/40000 km (R26.9k under) leads; 2019s are gen1.

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto, 40000 km, R279999, R26.9k under — newest, lowest-km auto.
2021 1.6D Executive diesel auto, 98000 km, R249990, R15.6k under — cheapest diesel auto.
2021 1.5 Premium manual, 81000 km, R199990, R34.4k under — biggest bargain, but manual.

hr-v.headline: Baseline: only two HR-Vs, both pre-2022 old gen with 448L boot and Magic Seats; 2021 Comfort auto R249990/57000 km is the pick.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.5 Comfort auto, 57000 km, R249990 — old gen, 448L boot + Magic Seats.
2020 1.8 Elegance auto, 50000 km, R298900 — higher trim, R49k dearer.
